Sample.evidence_source: [/page/8/Text/10] Remission rates using ITT analyses were 15/20 (75%) of the SPARX group compared to 5/12 (41.7%) of those in the wait group (Fishers Exact Test p = .130). Clinically significant change was 17/20 (85%) for the SPARX group and 5/12 (42%) in the wait group (Fishers Exact Test p = .018).

Source.evidence_source: [/page/8/Text/10] This resulted in CDRS-R pre-post mean changes of -13.9 (95% CI 10.0-17.9) for the SPARX group and -1.9 (95% CI -7.0-+3.3) for the waitlist; F 14.5, p = .001. The RADS pre-post mean change for SPARX was -4.5 (95% CI-9.0-+1.1) and for waitlist was +2.3 (95% CI -3.6-+8.1); F value 3.4, p = .075.
